paragraphs.en: What is moderation ( (适度) )? {Basically} , it means eating only as much food as your body needs.You should feel {satisfied} at the end of a {meal} , but not too full.For many of us, moderation means eating {less} than we do now.But it doesn't mean saying {goodbye} to the foods you loveIt's tempting to grab delicious foods like {ice-cream} , {chocolate} , and {bacon} , so consider the following tips to control your portion ( (食物的一份) ) sizes and make mindful choices.
paragraphs.cn: 什么是适度饮食？ <u> 从根本上说 </u> ，它意味着只吃身体所需的食物量。一 <u> 餐 </u> 结束后，你应该感到 <u> 满足 </u> ，但又不会觉得吃得过饱。对我们许多人来说，适度饮食意味着要比现在吃得 <u> 更少 </u> 。但这并不意味着你要 <u> 告别 </u> 你所喜爱的食物。像 <u> 冰激凌 </u> 、 <u> 巧克力 </u> 和 <u> 培根 </u> 这类美味的食物总是很诱人，所以不妨参考以下这些建议，以控制你的食物分量，并做出慎重的选择。

paragraphs.en: Take your timeIt's important to slow down and think about food as something {nutritious} rather than just something to eat in between meetingsDon't {swallow} a meal on the way to work.It actually takes a few minutes for your {brain} to tell your body that it has had enough food, so eat slowly and {cease} to eat before you feel full.
paragraphs.cn: 细嚼慢咽。放慢速度，把食物视为 <u> 营养 </u> 品，而不仅仅是会议间隙吃下的东西，这一点很重要。不要在上班途中狼 <u> 吞 </u> 虎咽地吃饭。实际上， <u> 大脑 </u> 需要几分钟的时间来告诉身体它已经吃饱了，所以要慢慢吃，并在感到饱之前就 <u> 停止 </u> 进食。

paragraphs.en: Include a variety of foods in your meals.For instance, adding {tofu} , {beans} , and {eggs} to your diet can provide essential protein without {excessive} calories.Vegetables like {tomatoes} , {onions} , and even {garlic} can enhance flavor while keeping dishes light.Cooking methods also matter.Instead of {frying} , try to {boil} or steam your food to reduce fat intake ( (摄取量) ).
paragraphs.cn: 饮食中应包含各种食物。例如，在饮食中加入 <u> 豆腐 </u> 、 <u> 豆类 </u> 和 <u> 鸡蛋 </u> ，既能获取必需的蛋白质，又不会摄入 <u> 过多 </u> 热量。 <u> 番茄 </u> 、 <u> 洋葱 </u> ，甚至 <u> 大蒜 </u> 等蔬菜可以在保持菜肴清淡的同时增添风味。烹饪方法也很重要。不妨尝试 <u> 煮 </u> 或蒸食物来替代 <u> 煎炸 </u> ，以减少脂肪的摄入。

paragraphs.en: Eat with others {whenever} possible.Eating alone, especially in front of the {TV} or {computer} , often leads to mindless {overeating} .And be {careful} about the foods you keep at handIt's more {challenging} to eat in moderation if you have {unhealthy} snacks at the {ready} , like cookies.Instead, {surround} yourself with healthy choices.
paragraphs.cn: <u> 尽 </u> 可能与他人一起用餐。独自吃饭， <u> 尤其 </u> 是在 <u> 电视 </u> 或 <u> 电脑 </u> 前，往往会导致无意识的 <u> 暴饮暴食 </u> 。还要 <u> 注意 </u> 身边存放的食物。如果身边 <u> 备 </u> 有 <u> 不健康的 </u> 零食，比如曲奇，那么适度进食就更 <u> 有挑战性 </u> 了。相反，让自己 <u> 置身 </u> 于健康的选择之中。

paragraphs.en: Be aware of the hidden calories in foods.Items like {butter} , {cream} , and {salty} snacks can add extra fat and sodium ( (钠) ) to your meals.When dining out at a {barbecue} or enjoying a {steak} , be mindful of the portion sizes.When it comes to snacks, instead of reaching for {candy} or {sausage} , try healthier options like fresh {watermelon} or a squeeze of {lemon} in your water.
paragraphs.cn: 注意食物中的隐藏热量。 <u> 黄油 </u> 、 <u> 奶油 </u> 和 <u> 咸味 </u> 零食等食物会给你的餐食增加额外的脂肪和钠。外出享用 <u> 烧烤 </u> 或 <u> 牛排 </u> 时，要注意分量。说到零食，与其去吃 <u> 糖果 </u> 或 <u> 香肠 </u> ，不如尝试新鲜的 <u> 西瓜 </u> 或在水中挤点 <u> 柠檬汁 </u> 等更健康的选择。

paragraphs.en: Control emotional {eating} .We don't always eat just to {satisfy} {hunger} .Many of us also turn to food to deal with {unpleasant} {emotions} such as {sadness} , {loneliness} , or {boredom} .But by learning healthier ways to manage emotions, you can {regain} control over the food you eat and your feelings.
paragraphs.cn: 控制情绪化 <u> 进食 </u> 。我们吃东西并不总是为了 <u> 满足饥饿感 </u> 。我们许多人还会通过食物来应对 <u> 悲伤 </u> 、 <u> 孤独 </u> 或 <u> 无聊 </u> 等 <u> 不愉快的情绪 </u> 。但是，通过学习更健康的情绪管理方法，你可以 <u> 重新 </u> 掌控自己的饮食和情绪。

paragraphs.en: Eat properly throughout the day.A healthy {breakfast} can start your metabolism ( (新陈代谢) ), while eating small, healthy meals keeps your energy up all day.Avoid eating late at night.Try to eat dinner earlier and go without food for {fourteen} to {sixteen} hours until breakfast the next morning.Studies suggest that eating only when you're most {active} and giving your {digestive} system a long break each day may help to {regulate} weight.
paragraphs.cn: 全天合理饮食。一顿健康的 <u> 早餐 </u> 可以启动你的新陈代谢，而少量健康的餐食能让你全天精力充沛。避免深夜进食。尽量早点吃晚餐，并坚持 <u> 14 </u> 到 <u> 16 </u> 个小时不吃东西，直到次日早餐。研究表明，只在最 <u> 活跃 </u> 的时候进食，每天给 <u> 消化 </u> 系统较长时间的休息，可能有助于 <u> 调节 </u> 体重。
